profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and headquartered in Katy, Texas, United States. The organization describes itself as dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good, and says it collaboratively designs and runs rigorous evaluations that make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

Its site describes three service lines. AI red teaming is offered as a paid service using the organization's own software, which it says it will release under an open source software license in 2026. AI Contextual Evaluations are described as rigorous, mixed-method, bespoke evaluations of a model or system's performance for a specified problem space, also a paid service, with the organization saying it is rapidly developing knowledge graph and ontological AI problem space mapping in 2026. Bias bounties are collaboratively designed sets of challenges bringing together researchers, impacted communities, and domain experts to examine AI and machine learning systems, models, and datasets. The final self-hosted bias bounty closed in November 2025, and in 2026 the organization says it is working to move the program onto Zindi, a global data science challenge platform. It directs inquiries to info@humane-intelligence.org or a contact form.

No lawsuits involving the organization are recorded, and Texas is the jurisdiction listed for its law exposure.
